templates.projectReadme:
# {{modName}}

Minecraft {{mcVersion}} / Fabric mod, generated by mcmodkit from a ModSpec.

## Build

```
gradlew.bat build      # Windows
./gradlew build        # macOS / Linux
```

The mod jar is written to build/libs/. The bundled Gradle wrapper ({{gradleWrapperVersion}}) needs a JDK {{javaVersion}} and downloads its dependencies on first run.

{{TEXTURE_NOTES}}

## Iterate

Edit the ModSpec JSON and regenerate. mcmodkit overwrites the files it manages (they carry a generated header comment) and never touches your own files.
templates.blockRegistration: public static final Block {{CONST_UPPER}} = register("{{REG_NAME}}", new Block({{SETTINGS}}));

notes: Uses Mojang official mappings (loom.officialMojangMappings()): API names are mojmap (net.minecraft.world.item.Item), NOT yarn.
Textures are not generated: add 16x16 PNGs under assets/<ns>/textures/{item,block}/<id>.png.
Compile-verified trap: BlockBehaviour lives in net.minecraft.world.level.block.state, NOT ...level.block (mojmap).
Version facts sourced from the CC0 fabric-example-mod (1.21.1 branch) and verified by compiling a generated project.
Derived from fabric-1.19.4, re-fitted with facts from scripts/version-facts.mjs (loader 0.19.5, pack_format 6 read from the real game jar).

SCOPE: items + blocks + textures only. UI/recipes/advancements/entities/datagen are deliberately absent because their templates are not version-independent (1.21.2+ alone changed MobRenderer's arity and EntityType.Builder#build). Asking for them fails with a clear error rather than emitting broken Java.

1.16.5 era: creative tabs come from FabricItemGroupBuilder (net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.itemgroup), whose create(id) -> icon() -> appendItems() -> build() self-registers: build() grows CreativeModeTab.TABS via fabric_expandArray() and the constructor finishes with TABS[id] = this. There is no ItemGroupEvents in fabric-item-groups-v0 for this version, so a vanilla tab is chosen at construction time with Item.Properties#tab() instead of through a post-registration hook.

1.16.5 era: net.minecraft.core.registries does not exist yet (that package is 1.19.3+). Registries are the static fields net.minecraft.core.Registry.ITEM / Registry.BLOCK. CreativeModeTab is still net.minecraft.world.item.CreativeModeTab with TAB_* constants, and it is not itself a registry.

1.16.5 era: BlockBehaviour.Properties.of() takes a Material; the argument-less overload is 1.20+. Item.Properties defaults to no creative tab at all (its constructor sets only maxStackSize and rarity), so an item only appears where it is explicitly placed.
org.slf4j is NOT on this version's loom compile classpath; the main class logs through org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager instead.
Datapack directories are PLURAL on 1.16.5 (data/<ns>/loot_tables/, data/minecraft/tags/blocks/), read from the real client jar. The singular 1.21 spelling fails silently in game.
Requires Java 8; build facts (loader 0.19.5, fabric-api 0.42.0+1.16, pack_format 6) come from scripts/version-facts.mjs reading meta.fabricmc.net, the Fabric maven and the real game jar.
